_doc: Single source of truth for the declarative Android Emulator desktop app (containers-cloud/android-emulator.nix). Profiles are GENERATED as forms × tiers (phone/tablet × light/full) — never a hardcoded list. `common_hw`/`tiers`/`forms` values are raw AVD config.ini keys, merged (common → tier → form; form wins) into each AVD's config.ini idempotently on `build.sh switch`. `provisioning` drives the idempotent post-boot adb steps run by the launcher.
_doc_arches: Profiles are GENERATED = forms × arches × tiers → 8: {Phone,Tablet}×{x86,arm}×{full,light}. x86 runs KVM-accelerated (fast — games/dev); arm runs the CPU in software (QEMU TCG, no KVM → faithful ARM test of arm64 APKs, but slower). Each arch carries its own system image, abi.type (→ AVD config.ini AND the install-time APK variant Cloud-SuperApp-<abi>.apk), and gpu_mode. gpu_mode is per-arch because hardware-GLES paths differ: x86 → `angle_indirect` (ANGLE translates guest GLES → Vulkan → real Intel Xe hardware; this is the actual GPU acceleration, NOT a software fallback — the host Vulkan ICD is wired via VK_ICD_FILENAMES in the launcher); arm → `swiftshader_indirect` (a TCG-emulated arm64 guest can't reliably drive host-GL translation, so faithful software GLES is the correct choice — arm profiles are for ABI/behaviour correctness, not frame rate). Change a value here → fast `switch` (system images are nix-store-cached; no re-download).

storage._doc: The heavy ~8.3G of system images + the AVDs live on the shared-lib drive (p5/ext4, ~83G free), NOT the 80G nix pool. nix still provides the emulator + platform/cmdline-tools (autoPatchelf'd, run natively on NixOS; nix-ld covers any downloaded binary); includeSystemImages=false in the .nix keeps the images out of /nix. At activation the module composes a p5 SDK (sdk_root) by symlinking the nix components into it, then runs `sdkmanager --sdk_root=<sdk_root>` to install the arches[].image system images there (idempotent — skips present packages, accepts licenses; network only on first run / new image). avdmanager creates the AVDs in avd_home; the nix emulator resolves their image.sysdir against ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=sdk_root → p5. TRADE-OFF (Principle 3): images download at first online switch instead of being nix-offline-cached — accepted for this local dev tool (apps build in GHA). The diego-owned p5 dirs are provisioned by a systemd-tmpfiles rule in the NixOS host (cloud-data-disk-protection.json) because /mnt/shared-lib is root-owned.

provisioning._doc: Idempotent post-boot steps applied via adb each launch. system_dark → `cmd uimode night yes`. home_launcher set via `cmd package set-home-activity`. superapp_launcher_theme pre-seeds launcher_theme_prefs.xml (key `theme`) via `adb run-as` (debug APK). apps[] installed if the package is absent; apk path may use $HOME and the `{abi}` token, which the launcher replaces with the booted profile's ABI (x86_64 / arm64-v8a) so each arch installs its matching native APK — a wrong-ABI install would defeat the 'real ARM test' goal. Build both once: `cd ~/git/unix/ea_cloud-superapp && SUPERAPP_VARIANT=x86_64 ./build.sh build && SUPERAPP_VARIANT=arm64-v8a ./build.sh build`.

testers._doc: Invariants proving the system images moved OFF the nix pool ONTO p5. Run after `ba_flakes_desktop/build.sh switch` (the first run must be online to download the images).
